```bash
cd /Users/liamellis/Desktop/apps/ultraterrestrial-resurrection/apps/disclosure-rag && find lib -name '*.py' -not -path '*/__pycache__/*' | sort | while read f; do
  # derive import stems
  mod="${f#lib/}"
  mod="${mod%.py}"
  mod="${mod%/__init__}"
  # skip empty init at root
  stem=$(basename "$mod")
  if [ "$stem" = "__init__" ]; then continue; fi
  # count references outside this file
  count=$(rg -l --glob '!**/__pycache__/**' --glob '!lib/**' -e "lib\.${stem}|from lib import.*${stem}|import lib\.${stem}|lib/${stem}" . 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
  internal=$(rg -l --glob '!**/__pycache__/**' --glob "lib/**" -e "from lib\.${stem}|import lib\.${stem}|from \.${stem}|from lib\..* import.*${stem}" . 2>/dev/null | grep -v "^${f}$" | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
  echo "$count|$internal|$f"
done | sort -t'|' -k1,1n -k2,2n
```
